note: Traditional-finance creator rates on the BUY rail are n=0. Every finance-vertical rate figure in this corpus is PLAT, a platform paying a creator out of ad revenue, not a brand buying a creator. Measured 2026-08-05 over 155 rate observations. Crypto is not a proxy: it prices as its own market. Round 5 ran 14 queries aimed at this gap on 2026-08-05.

No claim pairs a flat per-post rate with the views that post actually delivered. Repo-wide 7 claims come close and all 7 are bonus ladders or per-post caps rather than a realized pairing; inside the micro-pricing sweep it is 0. This is why no implied CPM can be computed for a flat rate here.

No operator states a multi-placement or bundle premium as a number, in either direction. A cross-post or story package is described qualitatively or not at all, so any uplift multiplier is unsupported by this corpus rather than contradicted by it.
Usage rights, whitelisting and exclusivity as a priced percentage add-on: n=1. Too thin to state a range. Operators discuss these terms qualitatively far more often than they price them.

A micro-influencer tier priced distinctly from a KOL sponsored post: n=1 at the per-thousand layer, and that single observation comes from a vendor selling against micro-influencers, so it is interested. The corpus does not establish micro as its own priced tier.

Rail and buy type are hand adjudicated on 135 claims out of 6,876. A regex classifier was written and reproduced the hand calls on only 22 percent, because the distinction turns on meaning rather than vocabulary, so it was deleted rather than shipped. Every unadjudicated claim carries a null rail. Absence of a rail is absence of adjudication, never evidence of absence.
